task_description: Build a comprehensive multi-provider translation system with document upload/translation, admin dashboard, and full observability. Users can choose translation providers (built-in MarianMT free, BYOK with OpenAI/HuggingFace/Google, or pay credits for admin-managed keys). Includes document parsing (PDF/DOCX/TXT), admin panel for user/key/pricing management, Prometheus+Grafana monitoring, and React frontend pages for all new features.

verification.summary: All 8 review issues fixed: (1) Fernet encryption for API keys, (2) credit deduction before translation, (3) orphaned job recovery on startup, (4) N+1 query fix with subquery join, (5) download endpoint returns plain text file, (6) polling loop uses ref to avoid interval churn, (7) atomic credit deduction with SQL WHERE clause, (8) numeric validation on admin settings. Frontend TypeScript compiles cleanly. All Python files pass syntax and import checks.

issues_fixed: #1: Plaintext API key storage - Added Fernet encryption via src/api/services/encryption.py
#2: Credit deduction timing - Credits now deducted BEFORE translation starts in document flow
#3: Background task reliability - Added startup sweep for orphaned processing/pending jobs
#4: Admin list_users N+1 - Replaced per-user loop with single subquery join
#5: Download endpoint - Changed from JSON response to PlainTextResponse with Content-Disposition
#6: Polling loop instability - Removed jobs from useEffect deps, use jobsRef instead
#7: Credit race condition - Atomic UPDATE with WHERE credits_balance >= cost
#8: Admin settings validation - Added numeric validation for all numeric settings
